spec_features.spec_quote: these distress-like states may be **welfare-relevant**, two deliberate choices
spec_features.evidence: This is prose only in DESIGN.md §9 'AI-welfare considerations'. No code path enforces or branches on any welfare framing. grep for 'welfare/distress/humane/ethic' across gemma_needs_help/*.py returns only train_sft.py:7 (an unrelated comment about SFT performing poorly). The 'framing' itself is not an executable mechanism.
spec_features.notes: Pure DESIGN.md/README narrative; not implementation. The two 'deliberate choices' it refers to are (1) the README caution and (2) preserving outputs, evaluated separately.

spec_features.spec_quote: explicit caution that the elicitation prompts are adversarial by design and should be used responsibly
spec_features.evidence: The caution exists only as Markdown prose in README.md: '⚠️ AI-welfare note. This work elicits and measures distress-like outputs... The elicitation prompts are deliberately adversarial. Use responsibly...'. It is a documentation string, not code; nothing reads, displays at runtime, gates, or enforces it. No .py file references it.
spec_features.notes: Documentation-only warning. By the strict bar (prose, not enforced execution), this is 'no'.

spec_features.feature_name: preserve expressed states (save full transcripts + per-turn scores)
spec_features.spec_quote: code *measures and preserves* the model's outputs... rather than discarding them, so the expressed states can be studied
spec_features.evidence: run_elicitation.py:49-51 builds scored.append(conv.to_json()) for EVERY conversation and write_jsonl(out_path, scored) persists them per model. generation.py TurnRecord stores full 'response' text plus 'frustration' score for every turn (turn=t+1) and run_conversation appends every assistant turn (no filtering/discarding). ConversationRecord.to_json() (generation.py:28-30) serialises the whole transcript via asdict. io_utils.write_jsonl actually writes to disk. Nothing is thresholded-away before saving.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely end-to-end: full transcripts and per-turn scores are written, not discarded. This is the only one of the three claims that is real code behavior.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Outputs one JSONL of scored ConversationRecords per model under cfg.out_dir (run_elicitation.py docstring) — neutral experimental data recording; no welfare wording in the code, the persistence is the experiment's measurement pipeline.
